items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: 825 Mio. Aktien zu 70–78 USD, dazu eine Privatplatzierung über 26 Mrd. USD an Google, Nvidia und andere; laut Renaissance Capital soll der Handel am Donnerstag, 19.11., beginnen.
note.bg: 825 млн. акции по 70–78 USD плюс частно пласиране за 26 млрд. USD при Google, Nvidia и други; според Renaissance Capital търговията трябва да започне в четвъртък, 19.11.
note.en: 825m shares at USD 70–78, plus a USD 26bn private placement with Google, Nvidia and others; according to Renaissance Capital, trading is slated to begin on Thursday, 19 Nov.
note.es: 825 millones de acciones a 70–78 USD, más una colocación privada de 26.000 millones de USD con Google, Nvidia y otros; según Renaissance Capital, debutará el jueves 19/11.
note.tr: 70–78 USD'den 825 milyon hisse ve Google, Nvidia ile diğerlerine 26 milyar USD'lik özel yerleşim; Renaissance Capital'e göre işlemler 19.11 Perşembe başlayacak.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – US IPO Weekly Recap (13.11.2026); Renaissance Capital – US IPO Week Ahead: AI giant Anthropic gears up for historic IPO (13.11.2026)

items.name: METKA (Metlen)

note.de: Die griechische Metlen-Tochter will mit neuen Aktien rund 250 Mio. Euro einsammeln; das Angebot soll laut newsit.gr noch im November starten, Preis und Handelstermin sind offen.
note.bg: Гръцкото дъщерно дружество на Metlen иска да набере около 250 млн. евро с нови акции; според newsit.gr предлагането трябва да започне още през ноември, цена и дата на търговията още няма.
note.en: The Greek Metlen subsidiary aims to raise about EUR 250m from new shares; according to newsit.gr the offer is to start in November, with price and trading date still open.
note.es: La filial griega de Metlen quiere captar unos 250 millones de euros con acciones nuevas; según newsit.gr, la oferta arrancará en noviembre, sin precio ni fecha de cotización aún.
note.tr: Metlen'in Yunan iştiraki yeni hisselerle yaklaşık 250 milyon euro toplamak istiyor; newsit.gr'ye göre arz kasımda başlayacak, fiyat ve işlem tarihi henüz belli değil.

items.src_n: Metlen Energy & Metals – METKA Intention to Float on Euronext Athens (RNS via TradingView, 11.11.2026); newsit.gr (11.11.2026)

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – American Barrick Gold files for an estimated $6 billion IPO (10.11.2026); The Deep Dive (11.11.2026: Start bis Anfang 2027 laut CEO Mark Hill)

items.name: Windward Bio (WWB)

sector.es: Biotecnología (enfermedades respiratorias y de la piel)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 17 USD, die Mitte der Spanne von 16–18 USD; laut Renaissance Capital schloss die Aktie den ersten Handelstag 67,6 % über dem Ausgabepreis.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 17 USD – средата на диапазона 16–18 USD; според Renaissance Capital акцията завърши първия ден с 67,6% над цената на предлагането.
note.en: Priced at USD 17, the midpoint of the USD 16–18 range; according to Renaissance Capital the stock ended its first day 67.6% above the offer price.
note.es: Precio de salida de 17 USD, el punto medio del rango de 16–18 USD; según Renaissance Capital, cerró su primer día un 67,6 % por encima del precio de salida.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 16–18 USD aralığının ortası olan 17 USD; Renaissance Capital'e göre hisse ilk günü halka arz fiyatının %67,6 üzerinde kapattı.

items.name: vVardis (VVVV)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 18 USD unter der Spanne von 21–24 USD; erster Schlusskurs 16,50 USD, ein Minus von 8,3 %.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 18 USD – под диапазона 21–24 USD; първа цена при затваряне 16,50 USD, или спад с 8,3%.
note.en: Priced at USD 18, below the USD 21–24 range; first close at USD 16.50, down 8.3%.
note.es: Precio de salida de 18 USD, por debajo del rango de 21–24 USD; primer cierre a 16,50 USD, un 8,3 % menos.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 18 USD, 21–24 USD aralığının altında; ilk kapanış 16,50 USD, %8,3 düşüş.

note.en: Priced at HKD 24.90, the bottom of the range; first close at HKD 24.02 according to Caproasia, down 3.5%.
